// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
/**
 * @file entropic.h
 * @brief Public C API for the Entropic inference engine.
 *
 * This is the unified facade. Most consumers link against librentropic
 * and include only this header. All functions are pure C — no C++ types
 * cross this boundary.
 *
 * @par Lifecycle
 * @code
 *   entropic_handle_t h = NULL;
 *   entropic_create(&h);
 *   entropic_configure(h, config_json);
 *   entropic_run(h, "Hello", &result);
 *   entropic_free(result);
 *   entropic_destroy(h);
 * @endcode
 *
 * @par Thread safety
 * Each function documents its thread safety class:
 * - **Thread-safe**: callable from any thread at any time.
 * - **Serialized per-handle**: one call at a time per handle;
 *   different handles are fully independent.
 * - **Single-threaded init/destroy**: must not race with any other
 *   call on the same handle.
 *
 * @par Error handling
 * Functions returning entropic_error_t set per-handle error state on
 * failure. Call entropic_last_error(handle) for the detailed message.
 *
 * @par Memory ownership
 * Functions returning char* transfer ownership to the caller.
 * Free with entropic_free(). Consumers providing buffers the engine
 * will free (e.g., hook modified_json) MUST allocate with
 * entropic_alloc(). Strings returned as const char* are owned by
 * the handle and valid until the next call on that handle.
 *
 * @version 1.9.10
 */

#pragma once

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include <entropic/entropic_config.h>
#include <entropic/entropic_export.h>
#include <entropic/types/error.h>
#include <entropic/types/hooks.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ── Lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * @brief Create a new engine instance.
 *
 * Allocates and initializes an engine handle. The engine is idle until
 * entropic_configure() is called.
 *
 * @param[out] handle Pointer to receive the new handle. Set to NULL on failure.
 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT — handle is NULL.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY — allocation failed.
 *
 * @threadsafety Single-threaded init/destroy.
 * @version 1.8.0
 */
ENTROPIC_EXPORT entropic_error_t entropic_create(entropic_handle_t* handle);

/**
 * @brief Configure the engine from a JSON config string.
 *
 * Parses the JSON, validates against the config schema, resolves model
 * paths, and prepares the engine for operation. Does NOT load models
 * (that happens on first generate or explicit activate).
 *
 * JSON is used at the C API boundary because it's universal — any language
 * can produce it. Config FILES are YAML (parsed by ryml inside
 * librentropic-config.so). Use entropic_configure_from_file() to load
 * YAML config files directly without manual JSON conversion.
 *
 * @param handle Engine handle.
 * @param config_json JSON string with engine configuration.
 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE — handle is NULL.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT — config_json is NULL.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_CONFIG — config validation failed.
 *
 * @threadsafety Serialized per-handle.
 * @version 1.8.0
 */
ENTROPIC_EXPORT entropic_error_t entropic_configure(
    entropic_handle_t handle,
    const char* config_json);

102	 * @brief Configure engine from a YAML or JSON config file.
103	 *
104	 * Convenience wrapper that reads the file, parses it (YAML via ryml or
105	 * JSON via nlohmann/json based on extension), and applies the configuration.
106	 *
107	 * @param handle Engine handle.
108	 * @param config_path Path to YAML (.yaml/.yml) or JSON (.json) config file.
109	 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
110	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE — handle is NULL.
111	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT — config_path is NULL.
112	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_CONFIG — config validation failed.
113	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_IO — file not found or unreadable.
114	 *
115	 * @threadsafety Serialized per-handle.
116	 * @version 1.8.0
117	 */
118	ENTROPIC_EXPORT entropic_error_t entropic_configure_from_file(
119	    entropic_handle_t handle,
120	    const char* config_path);
121	
122	/**
123	 * @brief Configure engine using layered config resolution.
124	 *
125	 * Loads configuration in priority order (highest wins):
126	 * 1. Compiled defaults
127	 * 2. Bundled default (data/default_config.yaml)
128	 * 3. Global config (~/.entropic/config.yaml)
129	 * 4. Project config ({project_dir}/config.local.yaml)
130	 * 5. Environment variables (ENTROPIC_*)
131	 *
132	 * This is the recommended configuration path for most consumers.
133	 * The project_dir also sets the working directory for log files
134	 * and session state (e.g., ".hello-world", ".entropic").
135	 *
136	 * @param handle Engine handle.
137	 * @param project_dir Project config directory (null-terminated).
138	 *        Contains config.local.yaml and receives session logs.
139	 *        Pass NULL or "" to use only global + bundled defaults.
140	 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
141	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE — handle is NULL.
142	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_CONFIG — config validation failed.
143	 *
144	 * @threadsafety Serialized per-handle.
145	 * @version 2.0.1
146	 */
147	ENTROPIC_EXPORT entropic_error_t entropic_configure_dir(
148	    entropic_handle_t handle,
149	    const char* project_dir);

151	/**
152	 * @brief Destroy an engine instance and free all resources.
153	 *
154	 * Unloads models, closes storage, destroys all child objects.
155	 * After this call, the handle is invalid. Passing NULL is a no-op.
156	 *
157	 * @param handle Engine handle to destroy (NULL-safe).
158	 *
159	 * @threadsafety Single-threaded init/destroy. Must not race with any
160	 *               other call on the same handle.
161	 * @version 1.8.0
162	 */
163	ENTROPIC_EXPORT void entropic_destroy(entropic_handle_t handle);

166	
167	/**
168	 * @brief Get the library version string.
169	 *
170	 * Returns the full semver string (e.g., "1.8.9"). The pointer has
171	 * static lifetime — valid for the entire process.
172	 *
173	 * @return Static null-terminated version string. Never NULL. Do NOT free.
174	 *
175	 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
176	 * @version 1.8.0
177	 */
178	ENTROPIC_EXPORT const char* entropic_version(void);
179	
180	/**
181	 * @brief Get the C API version number.
182	 *
183	 * Returns an integer starting at 1. Incremented on breaking changes:
184	 * signature changes, function removals, enum renumbering, or behavior
185	 * changes. Adding new functions does NOT increment this value.
186	 *
187	 * Compare with ENTROPIC_API_VERSION at compile time for version checks.
188	 *
189	 * @return API version integer.
190	 *
191	 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
192	 * @version 1.8.0
193	 *
194	 * @see ENTROPIC_API_VERSION (compile-time constant in entropic_config.h)
195	 */
196	ENTROPIC_EXPORT int entropic_api_version(void);
197	
198	/**
199	 * @brief Seconds since the engine last serviced a run (gh#35, v2.3.0).
200	 *
201	 * Returns the wall-clock seconds delta between now and the entry time
202	 * of the most recent `entropic_run*` call on this handle. Returns 0
203	 * when no run has ever happened on this handle (no activity to be
204	 * idle relative to).
205	 *
206	 * Intended for host-side idle-exit policies: a headless `entropic
207	 * serve` or sassafras-class consumer process can poll this at its own
208	 * cadence and call `entropic_destroy` once the engine has been idle
209	 * for longer than the host's configured threshold. The engine itself
210	 * does NOT auto-exit — that's a host policy decision.
211	 *
212	 * @param handle Engine handle. May be NULL.
213	 * @return Seconds idle, or 0 if handle is NULL / no activity yet.
214	 *
215	 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
216	 * @version 2.3.0
217	 */
218	ENTROPIC_EXPORT int64_t entropic_seconds_since_last_activity(
219	    entropic_handle_t handle);
220	
221	/* ── Memory ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
222	
223	/**
224	 * @brief Allocate memory using the engine's allocator.
225	 *
226	 * All cross-boundary allocations (hook modified_json, consumer-provided
227	 * strings that the engine will free) MUST use this function. Paired
228	 * with entropic_free().
229	 *
230	 * @param size Number of bytes to allocate.
231	 * @return Pointer to allocated memory, or NULL on failure.
232	 *
233	 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
234	 * @version 1.8.0
235	 */
236	ENTROPIC_EXPORT void* entropic_alloc(size_t size);
237	
238	/**
239	 * @brief Free memory allocated by the engine or entropic_alloc().
240	 *
241	 * All char* return values that transfer ownership MUST be freed with
242	 * this function. Passing NULL is a no-op.
243	 *
244	 * @param ptr Pointer to free (from engine return value or entropic_alloc).
245	 *
246	 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
247	 * @version 1.8.0
248	 */
249	ENTROPIC_EXPORT void entropic_free(void* ptr);

252	
253	/**
254	 * @brief Synchronous agentic loop.
255	 *
256	 * Runs the full agentic loop: generate, parse tool calls, execute tools,
257	 * re-generate until complete. Blocks until the loop finishes or is
258	 * interrupted via entropic_interrupt().
259	 *
260	 * @param handle Engine handle.
261	 * @param input User message (null-terminated).
262	 * @param[out] result_json JSON result string. Caller must free with entropic_free().
263	 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
264	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE — handle is NULL.
265	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_STATE — engine not configured.
266	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_GENERATE_FAILED — inference error.
267	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_ALREADY_RUNNING — another run in progress.
268	 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INTERRUPTED — cancelled via entropic_interrupt().
269	 *
270	 * @threadsafety Serialized per-handle.
271	 * @version 1.8.4
272	 *
273	 * @par Memory ownership
274	 * Caller must free *result_json with entropic_free().
275	 */
276	ENTROPIC_EXPORT entropic_error_t entropic_run(
277	    entropic_handle_t handle,
278	    const char* input,
279	    char** result_json);

282	 * @brief Single-turn agentic run under a named tier (gh#99).
283	 *
284	 * Per-call tier/grammar/identity selection on the shared resident model.
285	 * Runs `input` under `tier_or_identity`'s grammar + system prompt + samplers
286	 * without loading a second model or reconfiguring the handle — so one process

 * 2. Bundled default (data/default_config.yaml)
 * 3. Global config (~/.entropic/config.yaml)
 * 4. Project config ({project_dir}/config.local.yaml)
 * 5. Environment variables (ENTROPIC_*)
 *
 * This is the recommended configuration path for most consumers.
 * The project_dir also sets the working directory for log files
 * and session state (e.g., ".hello-world", ".entropic").
 *
 * @param handle Engine handle.
 * @param project_dir Project config directory (null-terminated).
 *        Contains config.local.yaml and receives session logs.
 *        Pass NULL or "" to use only global + bundled defaults.
 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE — handle is NULL.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_CONFIG — config validation failed.
 *
 * @threadsafety Serialized per-handle.
 * @version 2.0.1
 */
ENTROPIC_EXPORT entropic_error_t entropic_configure_dir(
    entropic_handle_t handle,
    const char* project_dir);

/**
 * @brief Destroy an engine instance and free all resources.
 *
 * Unloads models, closes storage, destroys all child objects.
 * After this call, the handle is invalid. Passing NULL is a no-op.
 *
 * @param handle Engine handle to destroy (NULL-safe).
 *
 * @threadsafety Single-threaded init/destroy. Must not race with any
 *               other call on the same handle.
 * @version 1.8.0
 */
ENTROPIC_EXPORT void entropic_destroy(entropic_handle_t handle);

/* ── Version ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * @brief Get the library version string.

 * Returns the full semver string (e.g., "1.8.9"). The pointer has
 * static lifetime — valid for the entire process.

 * @return Static null-terminated version string. Never NULL. Do NOT free.
 *
 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
 * @version 1.8.0

ENTROPIC_EXPORT const char* entropic_version(void);

 * @brief Get the C API version number.

 *
 * @return API version integer.
 *
 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.

 *
 * @see ENTROPIC_API_VERSION (compile-time constant in entropic_config.h)

ENTROPIC_EXPORT int entropic_api_version(void);

 * when no run has ever happened on this handle (no activity to be
 * idle relative to).

 * serve` or sassafras-class consumer process can poll this at its own
 * cadence and call `entropic_destroy` once the engine has been idle
 * for longer than the host's configured threshold. The engine itself
 * does NOT auto-exit — that's a host policy decision.
 *
 * @param handle Engine handle. May be NULL.
 * @return Seconds idle, or 0 if handle is NULL / no activity yet.
 *
 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
 * @version 2.3.0

ENTROPIC_EXPORT int64_t entropic_seconds_since_last_activity(
    entropic_handle_t handle);

/* ── Memory ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * @brief Allocate memory using the engine's allocator.
 *
 * All cross-boundary allocations (hook modified_json, consumer-provided
 * strings that the engine will free) MUST use this function. Paired
 * with entropic_free().
 *
 * @param size Number of bytes to allocate.
 * @return Pointer to allocated memory, or NULL on failure.
 *
 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
 * @version 1.8.0
 */
ENTROPIC_EXPORT void* entropic_alloc(size_t size);

/**
 * @brief Free memory allocated by the engine or entropic_alloc().
 *
 * All char* return values that transfer ownership MUST be freed with
 * this function. Passing NULL is a no-op.
 *
 * @param ptr Pointer to free (from engine return value or entropic_alloc).
 *
 * @threadsafety Thread-safe.
 * @version 1.8.0
 */
ENTROPIC_EXPORT void entropic_free(void* ptr);

/* ── Execution ────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * @brief Synchronous agentic loop.
 *
 * Runs the full agentic loop: generate, parse tool calls, execute tools,
 * re-generate until complete. Blocks until the loop finishes or is
 * interrupted via entropic_interrupt().
 *
 * @param handle Engine handle.
 * @param input User message (null-terminated).
 * @param[out] result_json JSON result string. Caller must free with entropic_free().
 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE — handle is NULL.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_STATE — engine not configured.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_GENERATE_FAILED — inference error.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_ALREADY_RUNNING — another run in progress.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INTERRUPTED — cancelled via entropic_interrupt().

 * @version 1.8.4
 *
 * @par Memory ownership
 * Caller must free *result_json with entropic_free().

ENTROPIC_EXPORT entropic_error_t entropic_run(
    entropic_handle_t handle,
    const char* input,
    char** result_json);

/**

 * without loading a second model or reconfiguring the handle — so one process
 * can interleave agent kinds (e.g. an "npc" verb-grammar tier and a
 * "companion" free-text tier) on a single resident model. Identical result
 * contract to entropic_run().
 *
 * @param handle Engine handle.
 * @param tier_or_identity Tier name to run this call under (null-terminated).
 * @param input User message (null-terminated).
 * @param[out] result_json JSON result string. Caller must free with entropic_free().
 * @return ENTROPIC_OK on success.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE — handle is NULL.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT — NULL tier/input/result_json.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_INVALID_STATE — engine not configured.
 *         - ENTROPIC_ERROR_IDENTITY_NOT_FOUND — unknown tier name.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
/**
 * @file entropic_export.h
 * @brief Symbol visibility macro for all exported symbols.
 *
 * Applied ONLY to:
 * - Factory functions (entropic_create_server, entropic_create_inference_backend)
 * - C API functions in entropic.h
 * - entropic_plugin_api_version()
 *
 * All other symbols are hidden by default (CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET=hidden).
 *
 * @version 1.8.0
 */

#pragma once

#if defined(ENTROPIC_STATIC_BUILD)
    /* Static build — no import/export decoration */
    #define ENTROPIC_EXPORT
#elif defined(_WIN32)
    #if defined(ENTROPIC_BUILDING_DLL)
        #define ENTROPIC_EXPORT __declspec(dllexport)
    #else
        #define ENTROPIC_EXPORT __declspec(dllimport)
    #endif
#else
    #define ENTROPIC_EXPORT __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#endif
